H2709.name: Hakupha
H2709.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2709.brief: A temple servant who returned from Babylonian exile.
H2709.short: Hakupha was among the temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

H2771B.name: Haran
H2771B.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2771B.brief: A descendant of Caleb, son of Caleb's concubine Ephah.
H2771B.short: Haran was a descendant of Caleb, born to Caleb's concubine Ephah, along with his brothers Moza and Gazez.

H2726.name: Harbona
H2726.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2726.brief: A eunuch in King Ahasuerus' court.
H2726.short: Harbona was one of the seven eunuchs who served King Ahasuerus, as mentioned in the book of Esther.

H2780.name: Hareph
H2780.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2780.brief: A descendant of Caleb, son of Hur.
H2780.short: Hareph, a descendant of Caleb, was the father of Beth-gader, as mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H2736.name: Harhaiah
H2736.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2736.brief: A goldsmith whose son helped repair Jerusalem's wall.
H2736.short: Harhaiah was a goldsmith whose son, Uzziel, was involved in repairing a section of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time.

H2745.name: Harhas
H2745.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2745.short: Harhas or Hasrah was the father of Shallum's wife.

H2744.name: Harhur
H2744.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2744.brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from exile.
H2744.short: Harhur was an ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylonian exile.

H2766G.name: Harim
H2766G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2766G.brief: A priestly division during David's reign.
H2766G.short: Harim was the name of a priestly division during King David's reign.

H2766H.name: Harim
H2766H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2766H.brief: A place whose people returned from Babylonian exile.
H2766H.short: Harim was a place whose people returned from Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel.

H2766J.name: Harim
H2766J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2766J.brief: One who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
H2766J.short: Harim was one of the individuals who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.

H2766I.name: Harim
H2766I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2766I.brief: Father of Malchijah, a builder of Jerusalem's wall.
H2766I.short: Harim was the father of Malchijah, a builder who repaired part of Jerusalem's wall.

H2756G.name: Hariph
H2756G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2756G.brief: One who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
H2756G.short: Hariph was one of the individuals who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.

H2774.name: Harnepher
H2774.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2774.short: Harnepher was a descendant of Asher, son of Zophah.

H2797.name: Harsha
H2797.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2797.brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from exile.
H2797.short: Harsha was an ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylonian exile.

H2739.name: Harumaph
H2739.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2739.brief: Father of Jedaiah, a repairer of Jerusalem's wall.
H2739.short: Harumaph was the father of Jedaiah, who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.

H2741.name: Haruphites
H2741.brief: A group of David's mighty men.
H2741.short: The Haruphites were a group of warriors among David's mighty men.

H2743.name: Haruz
H2743.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2743.brief: Father of Meshullemeth, wife of King Manasseh.
H2743.short: Haruz was the father of Meshullemeth, wife of King Manasseh of Judah.

H2700.name: Hazarmaveth
H2700.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2700.brief: A son of Joktan, descendant of Shem.
H2700.short: Hazarmaveth was a son of Joktan, a descendant of Shem, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

H2792.name: Heresh
H2792.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H2792.brief: A Levite who lived in Jerusalem.
H2792.short: Heresh was a Levite who resided in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H2753H.name: Hori
H2753H.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2753H.short: The Horites were a people group who inhabited the region of Seir before the Edomites.

H2753G.name: Hori
H2753G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2753G.brief: A spy from the tribe of Simeon.
H2753G.short: Hori, the son of Shaphat, was one of the twelve spies sent by Moses to explore the land of Canaan.

H2772.name: Horonites
H2772.brief: A people group opposed to Nehemiah's work.
H2772.short: The Horonites were a people group who opposed Nehemiah's efforts to rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.

H2798.name: Ge-harashim
H2798.brief: Valley of craftsmen; inhabited by Benjamites after the exile
H2798.short: Ge-harashim, the Valley of Craftsmen, was inhabited by some Benjamites after the return from the Babylonian exile.

H2732.name: Haradah
H2732.brief: A desert campsite during Israel's journey from Egypt.
H2732.short: Haradah was one of the places where the Israelites camped during their journey through the wilderness after leaving Egypt.

H2771A.name: Haran
H2771A.brief: A city in Mesopotamia, associated with Abraham and his family.
H2771A.short: Haran was a city in Mesopotamia where Abraham and his family settled after leaving Ur, and from where Abraham later departed for Canaan (<ref="Genesis 11:31-32; 12:4-5; 27:43; 28:10; 29:4; Act.7.2, 4">Genesis 11:31-32; 12:4-5; 27:43; 28:10; 29:4; Act.7.2, 4</ref>).

H2704.name: Hazar-enan
H2704.brief: Town on the northern border of Israel
H2704.short: Hazar-enan was a town located on the northern border of the Promised Land (Num.34.9-10) and the future inheritance of the tribe of Dan (<ref="Ezk.48.1">Ezk.48.1</ref>).

H2705.name: Hazar-shual
H2705.brief: Town allotted to Judah and Simeon
H2705.short: Hazar-shual was a town in the Negev allotted to Judah (<ref="Josh 15:28">Josh 15:28</ref>), later given to the tribe of Simeon (<ref="Josh 19:3; 1Ch.4.28">Josh 19:3; 1Ch.4.28</ref>), and inhabited by Jews after the Babylonian exile (<ref="Neh.11.27">Neh.11.27</ref>).

H2701.name: Hazar-susah
H2701.brief: Town allotted to the tribe of Simeon
H2701.short: Hazar-susah was a town in the Negev region, allotted to the tribe of Simeon during the division of the Promised Land (<ref="Josh 19:5">Josh 19:5</ref>).

H2702.name: Hazar-susim
H2702.brief: A town allotted to the tribe of Simeon.
H2702.short: Hazar-susim was a town allotted to the tribe of Simeon, mentioned in the list of their cities in 1 Chronicles.

H2776G.name: Heres
H2776G.brief: Place near where Gideon defeated the Midianites
H2776G.short: Heres was a place near the site where Gideon and his men defeated the Midianites (<ref="Judg 8:13">Judg 8:13</ref>).

H2768.name: Hermon Mount
H2768.brief: Mountain on the northern border of Israel
H2768.short: Mount Hermon, also known as Baal-hermon, Baal-hamon, Baal-gad, Senir, or Sirion, was a prominent mountain on the northern border of Israel (<ref="Deut 3:8-9; 4:48; Josh 11:3,17; 12:1,5,7; 13:5,11; 1Ch.5.23; Psa.29.6; 42:6; 89:12; 133:3; Sng.4.8; 8:11; Jer.18.14; Ezk.27.5">Deut 3:8-9; 4:48; Josh 11:3,17; 12:1,5,7; 13:5,11; 1Ch.5.23; Psa.29.6; 42:6; 89:12; 133:3; Sng.4.8; 8:11; Jer.18.14; Ezk.27.5</ref>).

H2765.name: Horem
H2765.short: Horem, a fortified city in the territory of Naphtali (<ref="Joshua 19:38">Joshua 19:38</ref>).

H2793G.name: Horesh
H2793G.brief: A wilderness area where David hid from Saul
H2793G.short: Horesh, a wilderness area in Judah where David hid from Saul.

H2735.name: Hor-haggidgad
H2735.brief: An Israelite campsite during the wilderness wanderings
H2735.short: Hor-haggidgad (Gudgodah), an Israelite campsite between Bene-jaakan and Jotbathah.

H2773.name: Horonaim
H2773.brief: A Moabite city mentioned in prophecies of judgment
H2773.short: Horonaim, a Moabite city featured in prophecies against Moab.

H2712A.name: Hukkok
H2712A.brief: A town on the border of Naphtali
H2712A.short: Hukkok, a town on the border of Naphtali (<ref="Joshua 19:34">Joshua 19:34</ref>).

H2777.name: Potsherd Gate
H2777.brief: A gate in Jerusalem mentioned by Jeremiah
H2777.short: The Potsherd Gate was a gate in Jerusalem near the Valley of Ben Hinnom, where Jeremiah was instructed to proclaim a message of judgment against Judah.
